FAQ

Exhibition Stand FAQ

Practical answers about exhibition stand design, production, logistics and installation — and what to expect when working with StandPoint.

01
Planning your stand

Getting started

How early should we start planning our exhibition stand?

The earlier the better, especially for larger or technically complex stands. The required lead time depends on the stand size, design complexity, exhibition schedule and venue requirements.

What information do you need to start?

Ideally, we need the exhibition name and dates, stand size and floor plan, your objectives, functional requirements, brand materials and any references you would like us to consider.

Can you prepare a stand design from our brief?

Yes. We can develop the stand from the initial brief, including layout, design concept, 3D visualisation and technical development.

Can you work with an existing stand design?

Yes. If you already have a design from your agency or in-house team, we can review it technically and develop it for production and installation.

What size custom stands do you usually build?

Our custom stand projects typically range from approximately 30 to 600 m², depending on the exhibition, location, complexity and schedule.

02
Design & production

From concept to build

What is included in a custom exhibition stand project?

Depending on the project, the scope can include design, technical development, production, graphics, lighting, AV, furniture, logistics, installation, on-site support and dismantling.

Do you produce exhibition stands yourselves?

Yes. StandPoint has its own production capabilities and also works with specialised production partners when a project requires specific materials or technologies. Production is coordinated as part of the complete StandPoint project.

Do you provide technical drawings and engineering?

Yes. Technical development is part of the project and includes the drawings, materials, finishes and specifications required to turn the approved design into a buildable stand.

Can you provide furniture, lighting, graphics and AV?

Yes. Furniture, graphics, signage, lighting, screens, AV equipment and other stand elements can be included and coordinated within the project.

Can you integrate products or special equipment into the stand?

Yes. Product displays, equipment, screens and other project-specific elements can be incorporated into the stand design, provided their technical requirements are known during development.

03
Logistics & on-site work

Delivery and installation

Where do you build exhibition stands?

StandPoint delivers exhibition stand projects for B2B trade fairs across Europe.

Do you handle venue requirements and technical approvals?

Yes. We prepare the technical project around the requirements of the relevant exhibition and venue and coordinate the documentation required for the stand build.

Do you organise transport?

Yes. Logistics can be coordinated as part of the project, including packing, transport and delivery timing according to the exhibition build-up schedule.

Do you install and dismantle the stand?

Yes. Our project scope can include on-site installation, handover and dismantling after the exhibition.

Is someone from StandPoint available during the exhibition?

Where required, we can provide on-site support for adjustments and technical issues during the event.

04
Choosing the right solution

Custom stands or group builds

What is the difference between Custom Stands and Group Stand Construction?

Custom Stands are designed individually for one exhibitor and its specific brand, floor space and requirements.

Group Stand Construction is intended for organisers, national pavilions and multi-exhibitor areas where multiple stands need to follow one coordinated structural and visual system.

Custom Stands Explore Group Stands
Can you build several stands for us at the same exhibition?

Yes. The appropriate approach depends on the number of stands, their sizes and whether they need individual designs or a shared construction system. Send us the floor plans and requirements and we can recommend the most suitable format.

Can you work with our agency or in-house design team?

Yes. We can work directly with your marketing team, exhibition department, design agency or other project partners, depending on how responsibilities are divided.

05
Costs & quotation

Budgeting your project

How much does a custom exhibition stand cost?

The cost depends on the stand size, design, materials, technical requirements, equipment, exhibition location, logistics and build-up schedule. Once we have the floor plan and project requirements, we can prepare a more meaningful estimate.

What do you need to prepare a quotation?

At minimum, send us the exhibition, stand dimensions or floor plan, dates, your main requirements and any available references or brand guidelines. The more information we have at the beginning, the more accurate the proposal can be.

Do you provide an initial concept?

Yes. For suitable projects, we can prepare an initial stand concept so you can evaluate the proposed design direction and project approach before moving forward.
